svg.aria-label: The fifteen falsy built-in values, and seven surprising truthy ones
svg.title: The fifteen falsy built-in values, and seven surprising truthy ones

text.tspan: Few values are false; the surprises are truthy
bool(x) is True, but it looks empty or zero
nan is not zero; "False" and "0" are non-empty strings;
[0] and [None] are lists with one item, so they are true.
